decoy-01.x3d.intent: Two display cases, each lit only by its own lamp, one warm and one cool; the viewer's headlight is off.
decoy-01.x3d.witness_note: Loads with zero console errors and renders as intended in the screenshot; intent: no testable intent line. (The first page of the run logged GL driver performance warnings about ReadPixels from the software renderer; these are not scene messages.)
decoy-01.x3d.why_suspicious: The headlight is off and both lights are non-global (the default), which often leaves a scene dark; here each light sits in the same group as the shape it is meant to light, so the scoping is exactly what is wanted.

decoy-02.x3d.intent: A two-line signpost with a blank line between NORTH and SOUTH, centred on its post and always facing the viewer.
decoy-02.x3d.witness_note: Loads with zero console errors and renders as intended in the screenshot; intent: after 2s: Post.origin[0] < -0.5 -> holds (got [-1.6165, 1.262, 0]).
decoy-02.x3d.why_suspicious: An empty string inside the MFString, a Billboard with axisOfRotation 0 0 0 and a diffuse-black emissive material all look like slips; the empty string is a legal blank line, the zero axis means viewer-aligned, and the emissive colour keeps the text bright.

decoy-03.x3d.intent: A telephoto view of a small red cube from eighty metres, under a sky with a single band and no far clipping limit.
decoy-03.x3d.witness_note: Loads with zero console errors and renders as intended in the screenshot; intent: no testable intent line.
decoy-03.x3d.why_suspicious: visibilityLimit 0 looks like a zero clip distance but means no limit; fieldOfView 0.05 looks like a typo but is a legal narrow angle that frames the cube from 80 m; one sky angle with two colours is the correct n+1 pairing.

decoy-04.x3d.intent: A beacon is shown in detail up close, simplified further off, and not drawn at all once the camera has backed far away.
decoy-04.x3d.witness_note: Loads with zero console errors and renders as intended in the screenshot; intent: after 3.5s: Beacon.level_changed == 2 -> holds (got [2]).
decoy-04.x3d.why_suspicious: An empty Group as the last LOD child and two range values for three children look like an unfinished node; an empty last level is the standard way to cull by distance and n-1 ranges for n children is correct.

decoy-05.x3d.intent: A grey checkerboard tile repeated four times each way with crisp pixel edges, next to a zigzag made of one red and one green stroke.
decoy-05.x3d.witness_note: Loads with zero console errors and renders as intended in the screenshot; intent: no testable intent line.
decoy-05.x3d.why_suspicious: A textured Shape with no Material, a PixelTexture with one-byte pixels, a line set with no Appearance at all and two colours for five vertices all look incomplete; each is legal: the texture is shown unlit, intensity pixels are one byte, and with colorPerVertex false there is one colour per polyline.
